issue.title: Remote stop rejected for a missing lifecycle.stop capability is journaled as acceptance_uncertain and never settles
issue.description:
Athena's `~/.sase/fleet/dispatch_mutation_intents.json` held 69 remote `stop`
intents against apollo, created 2026-09-09 through 2026-09-11. Every one has
`status: acceptance_uncertain` and `error: "missing lifecycle capability
lifecycle.stop"`.

A missing capability is a definitive rejection, not an uncertain acceptance.
The mutation submit path in `src/sase/dispatch/mutations.py` marks the intent
`acceptance_uncertain` before calling `mutate_sync` and keeps that status when
the call raises `FederationWorkerResponseError`, so the rejection is journaled
as uncertain and never settles.

The targeted rows were remote agents the owner no longer treated as running:
dead or presentation-terminal rows that the gateway serves without lifecycle
capabilities. About 50 of the intents were created within four seconds on
2026-09-10 17:09Z, which points at a batch stop path that submits without
checking the row's advertised capabilities (compare
`remote_capability_enabled` in
`src/sase/ace/tui/actions/agents/_remote_lifecycle.py`). Confirm which path
submitted them before fixing.

task_type_fields.impact:
A user trying to stop a remote row that cannot be stopped gets no definitive
"not running, cannot stop" outcome. The intent stays uncertain forever, the row
stays visible, and repeated attempts pile up stale journal records: 69 on athena
while trying to clear two phantom Apollo agents.
task_type_fields.location: src/sase/dispatch/mutations.py remote mutation submit (acceptance_uncertain kept on FederationWorkerResponseError)
task_type_fields.repro:
1. On a controller with an enrolled remote, pick a remote Agents-tab row that
   does not advertise `lifecycle.stop`, for example a dead agent the owner still
   serves as a recent-terminal row, and submit a remote stop from ACE.
2. Inspect `~/.sase/fleet/dispatch_mutation_intents.json`: the new record has
   `status: acceptance_uncertain` with `error: "missing lifecycle capability
   lifecycle.stop"` instead of a settled rejection.
3. Evidence on athena (2026-09-12):
   `jq -r '.records[] | "\(.status)\t\(.error)"' ~/.sase/fleet/dispatch_mutation_intents.json | sort | uniq -c`
   prints `69 acceptance_uncertain	missing lifecycle capability lifecycle.stop`.
